name: session-list
summary: The devices signed in to an account: one row per session with a device icon, browser and system, location and last activity, a "This device" marker on the current one, a Sign out button on the others and a confirmed "Sign out everywhere else".
useWhen: A security or account settings page lets people review where they are signed in and end sessions they do not recognise.
Someone suspects their account is in use elsewhere and needs one action to sign every other device out.

alternatives.name: settings-section
alternatives.when: the page holds ordinary settings, such as profile or notifications, not a list of sessions

alternatives.name: table
alternatives.when: an admin reviews many members' sessions at once and needs sorting and columns

rules.do: List the current session first with a "This device" badge and no Sign out button.
rules.dont: Offer Sign out on the current device in this list; it ends the session people are using to secure their account.

rules.do: Confirm "Sign out everywhere else" in an alert dialog that says how many devices it affects.
rules.dont: Sign every device out on one click; a mis-tap logs a whole team's shared screens out.

rules.do: Give each row a location and a last-active time written for people, such as "Lisbon, Portugal · 2 hours ago".
rules.dont: Show raw IP addresses or ISO timestamps that nobody can recognise at a glance.

a11y: The section is named by its heading. Each Sign out button names the device it ends, such as "Sign out Safari on iOS 18, Lisbon, Portugal".
Device icons are decorative; the browser and system text says what the device is.
The result of each sign-out is announced through a status region; buttons show a spinner with a label while it runs.
